summary.text: Catherine 'Barcy' Whitson is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate. According to her campaign website, she had a career in the insurance industry and has spent about 20 years as a volunteer life coach, pastor and mentor.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, she had a successful career in the insurance industry before spending the last 20 years volunteering as a life coach, pastor and mentor.
Says she is running for the 2027-2033 term to promote 'What Tennesseans Want' and is on the ballot as an independent, and goes by Barcy.
